reporting-org.narrative: European Commission - Directorate-General for International Partnerships

description.narrative: Within the framework of promoting a rules-based multilateralism and partnerships to achieve the SDGs, the Overall Objective of this action is to mobilise support expenditure for the implementation of the 3 "specific objectives" of NDICI-Global Europe-Global Challenges-Partnerships (cf. Global Challenges MIP): 1. Enhanced global and multilateral partnerships; 2. Stronger economic governance and inclusive societies; and 3. Strengthened local authorities at global level.The Specific Objectives of this action are to: 1. Support activities and practitioners involved in ensuring and/or multiplying the impact of operational interventions funded through the NDICI instrument (notably, the Partnerships component of Global Challenges). 2. Reinforce monitoring, evaluation and auditing activities of actions and programmes funded through NDICI (notably, the Partnerships component of Global Challenges).  3. Provide support in the design of actions, programmes and strategies which require a more in-depth analysis, including on cross-cutting issues. 4. Promote policy dialogue, communication/visibility, public diplomacy activities, capacity-building, technical preparation, and any support needed to facilitate joint programming and Team Europe and Global Gateway coordination at country level.Therefore, this action can include multi-sector support and serve both headquarters and Union delegations.In terms of timeline, this action is intended to support the work of HQs and EUDs through the end of the current MFF 2021-2027 and the very beginning of the new MFF 2028-2034, with a total planned amount of EUR 1,700,000 ¿ divided into EUR 800,000 from 2025¿s Partnerships budgetary appropriations; EUR 500,000 from 2026¿s Partnerships budgetary appropriations; and EUR 400,000 from 2027¿s Partnerships budgetary appropriations.
